## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who experiences this pain point?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution. How would it work?

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this the best option?

## Impact

Who would benefit from this feature? How would it improve their experience?

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, diagrams, or examples that help illustrate the feature.
